en-US.description: Convert your music to any format
en-US.longDescription: MediaHuman Audio Converter is a free application for macOS and Windows. With it you can convert music in formats like MP3, AAC, WMA, OGG, etc. as well as in lossless formats like FLAC, Apple Lossless, AIFF, WAV (up to 32 bit).
en-US.name: MediaHuman Audio Converter
